units.function: Embedded-Postgres HTTP tests for read-only direct-blocker diagnostics with anomaly flags, dependency readiness, low-trust filtering, cross-tenant privacy and bounded output.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest -> Issue diagnostics route/auth -> real Issue/access services -> PostgreSQL Issues, relations, Agents, projects and Runs.
units.keyDataModels: Issue blocker relation, structured readiness counts, blocker flags, prose diagnosis, authorization trust boundary, omitted-node count and truncation cap.
units.lifecycle: Authorize source Issue -> fetch up to 100 blocker nodes -> filter each by visibility -> compute readiness only for complete visible result -> return flags/caps/prose diagnosis; no mutation occurs.
units.testAssessment: All 5 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Source specifies valuable incompleteness semantics, but recursive graph, consistency, non-admin identities, scale and access auditing remain unverified.
units.designRationale: Give operators an actionable explanation for stale blocker holds without leaking hidden blocker payloads or claiming readiness from incomplete or truncated information.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe graph diagnostics for Agent Boss and support staff that distinguish fact, inference and unknown while respecting tenant, project, responsibility and data-classification boundaries.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT structured readiness/flags, uniform cross-tenant 404, visible-data-only diagnosis and readiness=null whenever authorization/truncation makes evidence incomplete. Replace English prose contract with codes/parameters, policy-control hidden cardinality, add snapshot version/cursor, recursive cycle-safe diagnostics, read receipts, rate limits and separate customer versus privileged support views.
units.responsibilityConflict: A diagnostic is an inference, not authoritative responsibility evidence. Hidden-node counts may reveal protected organizational structure, and no accountable reader/access receipt is asserted.
units.securityFindings: HIGH verification gap: all database/HTTP tests skipped. MEDIUM hidden-cardinality leak: omittedUnauthorizedBlockerCount reveals protected graph size. MEDIUM identity-coverage gap: non-admin/inactive/scoped-key cases are absent. MEDIUM access-audit gap: sensitive diagnostics reads have no asserted receipt. MEDIUM consistency gap: no graph snapshot/version under concurrent changes. MEDIUM abuse gap: recursion, ordering, pagination and query-rate limits are absent.
